scriptAction.script: import de.hybris.platform.core.Registry import de.hybris.platform.core.enums.OrderStatus def ms = Registry.applicationContext.getBean('modelService') def o = process.order ms.refresh(o) if (o.status != OrderStatus.CANCELLED) { o.status = OrderStatus.COMPLETED ms.save(o) } org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger('flamengo-expedicao').info('Pedido ' + o.code + ': remessas finalizadas, pedido ' + o.status) return 'OK'
